title: 36 Hours in Boston
abstract: Beyond Boston’s bricks and brownstones lies a city with a more modern sheen.

title: 36 Hours in Montreal
abstract: In super-friendly Montreal, a music-charged night life, meat-centric restaurants and post-industrial revival add to the allure.

title: 36 Hours in Portland, Me.
abstract: In recent years, this city has welcomed a wave of locavore restaurants, urban farms and galleries that feature local artists.

title: 36 Hours in Sonoma County
abstract: Low-key Sonoma County combines a freethinking tradition with upscale shops, galleries and Old World restaurants.
